name: series_id
description: BLS LABSTAT series identifier; see the series table

name: mean
description: Published estimate: mean annual expenditure or income per consumer unit, or the mean characteristic
observations: Unit is US dollars for expenditure and income items; consumer-unit characteristics (e.g. persons, age, percent) carry the unit named in the item

name: relative_standard_error
description: Relative standard error of the mean

name: expenditure_share
description: Share of the item in average annual expenditures of the group

name: aggregate_expenditure
description: Aggregate expenditure on the item for the group
observations: For characteristics other than all consumer units, BLS reports the share of the aggregate instead

name: aggregate_share
description: Share of the aggregate expenditure on the item accounted for by the group

name: percent_reporting
description: Percentage of consumer units in the group reporting an expenditure on the item

name: footnote_codes
description: Footnote codes attached to the mean estimate
